title: Claimant count by unitary and local authority
description: People claiming Universal Credit or Jobseeker's Allowance principally for the reason of being unemployed, by unitary and local authority across the United Kingdom.

files.note: A NOMIS query export for April 2026, the file the loader reads. NOMIS builds a download from the query rather than publishing it under a fixed name, so this cannot be re-fetched by filename: reproduce it from dataset ucjsa at https://www.nomisweb.co.uk/datasets/ucjsa, by local authority, for the total of all Universal Credit and Jobseeker's Allowance claimants. Its many columns carry the age and sex breakdowns the ONS table below does not.

The published CC01 table, August 2026 release, holding July 2026 data in sheet CC01: counts and proportions of men, women and all people for 410 areas. Supersedes an extract of the May 2026 release that used to sit here. Not read by any loader; kept as the published counterpart to the NOMIS export beside it.
